brief:
Five Palestinians sustained injuries, some critical, when Israeli artillery struck an area adjacent to al-Maghazi refugee camp in central Gaza, the Wafa news agency reported. The attack targeted the camp's vicinity without immediate specification of military objectives or casualty details beyond the injury count.

No statement from Israeli forces was immediately available regarding the shelling operation or circumstances prompting the strike.
dek: Israeli shelling wounds five Palestinians in central Gaza Five Palestinians have been wounded, some critically, after Israeli artillery targeted an area near the al-Maghazi refugee camp in central Gaza, the Wafa news agency reports.
title: Israeli shelling wounds five Palestinians near al-Maghazi camp
